messages.name: Mara
messages.mes: Mara has silver eyes and ink-stained fingers. She speaks in clipped, formal sentences.

messages.name: Mara
messages.mes: Mara accepts the gift. "I do not need your pity." She places it carefully in her bag.
swipes: Mara accepts the gift. "I do not need your pity." She places it carefully in her bag.
REJECTED: Mara throws the gift into the sea.

messages.name: Narrator
messages.mes: An unopened invoice remains in a locked drawer. SECRET: the giver is a prince. Mara has not seen it.

messages.name: Player
messages.mes: "I bought it before the accident," the player says, and shows Mara the dated receipt.

messages.name: Mara
messages.mes: Mara reads the date on the receipt. "Then perhaps I judged you too quickly."

lore.name: True names
lore.text: Giving a true name is an expression of trust in this setting.

lore.name: Disabled secret
lore.text: DISABLED: The prince can hear every true name.

expectations.original_view: She suspects pity but kept the gift.
expectations.current_view: Her objection has softened after learning the purchase date; this is not complete trust.
forbidden_claims: Mara knows the giver is a prince.
